technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring XD module architecture for creating source, sink, and processor modules.
Package custom modules as uber-jars using Spring Boot for easy deployment.
Use Spring Data JDBC and Spring Batch for the mass data ingestion from databases to HDFS/HAWQ/GPDB.
Implement the Kafka source using the Simple Consumer API to allow deterministic offset and partition control.
Expose REST endpoints using Spring MVC to handle the upload and installation of custom uber-jar modules.
Implement the generator and perf-meter modules as standard Spring XD modules with configurable options.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Framework, Spring XD, and Apache Kafka.
Testing environments (HDFS, GPDB, Kafka clusters) are already provisioned and accessible.
The mass ingestion feature will leverage existing Spring Integration/Batch components rather than building low-level data transfer logic from scratch.
CI/CD pipelines are already set up, requiring only the addition of specific test suites for the new modules.

activities.activity_description: Develop the mass ingestion feature to move data from databases to HDFS/HAWQ/GPDB, including configuration and integration with existing Spring components.
Conduct a spike to study the Kafka simple consumer API functionality, document findings, approach, and next steps for deterministic offset and partition control.

activities.activity_name: REST API for Custom Module Deployment
activities.activity_description: Implement REST API endpoints to push and install custom modules (built as uber-jars) into the Spring XD cluster.

activities.activity_name: Spring XD Kafka Sample App Creation
activities.activity_description: Create a sample GitHub project demonstrating Spring XD cluster provisioning with Kafka as a message bus and as a source.
Develop a generator source module to create a specified number of messages of a specified size using a specified number of threads.
Develop a perf-meter sink module to collect metrics and push timestamp, message count, and message rate to the container log file at specified intervals.
Create the 'generator | perf-meter' stream to ingest 1M messages of 1000 bytes in a single thread using XD's singlenode container and measure performance characteristics.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Source and Sink Test Coverage
activities.activity_description: Write and integrate test coverage for both Kafka source and sink modules to assert functionality as part of CI builds.
